guestHint: You're playing as a guest. Sign in to pick a name and avatar.

createRoom.gameTooMany: Up to {max} players: the room has {count}
createRoom.visibilityHint: Every room shows up in the room list. Public: anyone can join. Private: joining asks for the password.
createRoom.needPassword: Set a password for the private room.
createRoom.seatsHint: The match can start with 2 players or more.
createRoom.seatsHintImpostor: A match can start with 3 or more players.

voteSeconds.label: Time to vote
voteSeconds.hint: Everyone votes on the theme before the match. Each vote takes an even share of this time off for whoever is still voting.

askSeconds.label: Time to ask
askSeconds.hint: Whoever's turn it is writes a yes-or-no question.

answerSeconds.label: Time to answer
answerSeconds.hint: Everyone else answers. Each answer takes an even share of this time off for whoever is still answering: a third with three answering, half with two.

guessSeconds.label: Time to guess
guessSeconds.hint: After the answers, the player guesses who they are or passes.

validateSeconds.label: Time to check the guess
validateSeconds.hint: Whoever picked the character checks a guess that wasn't an exact match.

replySeconds.label: Time to answer
replySeconds.hint: Everyone answers the question for their own card. Each answer cuts an even share of this time for those still left; changing it gives it back.

talkSeconds.label: Time to talk and vote
talkSeconds.hint: Pointing is free. Each confirmed vote cuts a share, but 20 s to talk always remain; taking it back gives it back.

lastSeconds.label: Last chance
lastSeconds.hint: A caught impostor tries to guess the crew's card.

lotSeconds.label: Time per lot
lotSeconds.hint: How long a lot lasts at the auction. A bid in the last 5 s puts 5 s back on the clock.

tradeSeconds.label: Time to trade
tradeSeconds.hint: After the auction, each player can offer one trade. Ends early once everyone confirms.

defendSeconds.label: Time to build the board
defendSeconds.hint: After the mission, each team arranges its photos and writes on its board. Ends early once everyone confirms.

judgeSeconds.label: Time to judge
judgeSeconds.hint: A secret vote for the best board, your own counts too. Ends early once everyone votes.

createRoom.gostosHint: Turn off what nobody here wants to see: those characters leave the themes, and a theme left with too few leaves the room.
createRoom.themesHint: Everyone votes: before each match, 4 of the themes you keep on go to a quick vote. I type it: you write the theme when the match starts.
createRoom.themesHintVote: Before each match, 4 of the themes you keep on go to a quick vote.
createRoom.hiddenByGostos: {count, plural, one {# theme hidden} other {# themes hidden}} by the tastes.
createRoom.hostNote: When the match starts, you write any theme you like, with a few ideas from the themes on. If 30 s go by, everyone votes instead.

lineup.coinsHint: Everyone starts each round with these coins to bid with.
lineup.lotsHint: How many characters go to auction per person at the table, plus 3.
lineup.roundsHint: Auto: 2 rounds up to 4 people, 1 after that.
lineup.intervalHint: A pause to see everyone's team and the coins they have left.
lineup.tradesHint: Before the mission, each player can offer to swap characters with another team.
lineup.missionsHint: Each round draws one of the missions you keep on. New missions start on.
lineup.heavyHint: Shipwrecks, funerals and others that may weigh on the table.
lineup.cardsOn: {count, plural, one {# character up for auction} other {# characters up for auction}}
lineup.needCards: Too few characters: turn more tastes on.
lineup.gostosHint: Turn off what nobody here wants to see: those characters stay out of the auction.

impostor.pitch: Everyone has the same character but one, who doesn't even know. Answer for your card with a tap and vote out whoever stands out.

demoLines: To get a cow up the stairs.
To get the cat off the fridge.
To announce the end of the world.
To save everyone on the Titanic.
whatFor.pitch: Everyone buys a team at a character auction, without knowing what for. Then the envelope opens on the mission, and everyone defends their board.

lines: To sell ice to penguins, in the dead of winter.
To get a cow up the stairs, backwards.
To talk the cat down from the fridge.
To announce the end of the world, live.
To save everyone on the Titanic, with a bucket.
